text:
**Short answer:** for most people, WIRED's top pick is the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 stand. If you have a recent iPhone and want 25W charging, the ESR CryoBoost is the best value I found.

## Top picks

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand**
- WIRED's best overall. It charges the iPhone at up to 15W, fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and has an AirPods pad on the base.
- The phone pad tilts, works in landscape for StandBy, and comes with a 2-year warranty.
- WIRED lists it at $98, with $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy.
- [WIRED's review and buy links](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best value for 25W: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2, 25W)**
- It has an active cooling fan, and WIRED notes a button to turn the fan off at night. A 50W adapter is included.
- It's $99.99 at ESR. Dealectric says code PARTNER18 took $17.99 off in ESR's cart on 2026-10-23, for about $82.
- [Buy at ESR via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). This is an affiliate link and pays Dealectric a commission at no cost to you. Check the final price at checkout.
- 25W applies only to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older models get 15W.
- WIRED reviewed it as a folding travel charger and called the plastic build not premium. Dealectric lists a 12-month warranty (24 with registration), while WIRED lists 2 years.
- [WIRED travel charger guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

**Fastest and most premium: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
- It delivers 25W to the iPhone and has a glossy, heavy base.
- No power adapter is included. You need a 40W one, such as Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter at $25.
- [WIRED's review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best stand that also folds: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, Qi2 25W ($129.99)**
- It's the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand Macworld has tested, and it lifts the iPhone over 70mm.
- It includes a 45W adapter with UK and EU plugs.
- [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)

**Best if you want it out of sight: Nimble Podium 3-in-1 ($130)**
- The pads lie flat, or pop up for StandBy and Nightstand modes. It supports 25W for the iPhone.
- Apple Watch charging is slow, so it's best left overnight.
- [WIRED's review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## Which to pick
- **Charging mostly overnight:** WIRED says 25W makes little difference, so the Belkin at about $80 to $98 is plenty.
- **iPhone 17 or 16 Pro Max and you want speed:** the ESR CryoBoost is cheapest, and the Nomad is the premium option.
- **Want a taller desk stand that folds for trips:** the Satechi.
- **Tight budget:** WIRED named the 15W ESR Qi2 3-in-1 its best cheap pick, at $40 on Amazon during a sale (normally $80). I don't have a direct link to that listing, so search for it by name on Amazon.

I didn't have direct purchase links for the Belkin, Nomad or Nimble, so the links above go to WIRED's guide, which has the retailer buttons. Prices change, so confirm them at checkout. Make sure your AirPods case supports wireless charging.
